profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer | Full‑Stack, Data Engineering & Cloud | .NET, Java, Python | Angular, React | Azure, AWS | Lending & Loan Systems | Fin Reporting & Risk | ETL, DevOps | Power BI, Power Apps | AI (LLMs) | GCHolder
profile.summary:
✅ Full Stack Expertise: Proficient in .NET (Core 1–3, 6 & 8), Angular (2–14), ReactJS, and ASP.NET MVC for scalable web and desktop applications. 

✅ Data Mastery: Skilled in ETL, Data Warehousing, Power BI, Tableau, and SQL Server | Oracle for insightful reporting and analytics. 

✅ Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on experience with Azure, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization tools like Docker and Kubernetes. 

✅ Financial Systems: Expertise in regulatory reporting tools (RegReporter, Axiom, LoanIQ, Comercial Landing Systems, TradeInno, RealState, Mortage ) and market risk analysis with Bloomberg API integration. 

✅ Distributed Systems: Designed scalable solutions using Kafka, RabbitMQ, and microservices architecture. 

✅ Agile Leader: Practiced in SCRUM, RUP, and CMMI methodologies, ensuring efficient project delivery.
 
✅ Global Collaboration: Thrives in diverse teams, delivering solutions across the USA, Spain, Mexico, and England.

✅AI-Driven Engineering WorkflowsBuilding AI-driven engineering workflows using autonomous agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations, and graph-based architectures combined with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Transforming software investigation, technical planning, and execution into structured, reusable, context-aware workflows grounded in real system artifacts, including source code, database schemas, dependencies, and architectural relationships. Improving engineering accuracy, reducing guesswork, and enabling more consistent, traceable, and repeatable software development processes.Agentic AI Orchestration amp; Engineering AutomationDesigning and developing multi-agent orchestration workflows using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and Microsoft Azure AI Foundry to coordinate AI-driven software engineering activities across the development lifecycle. Building specialized agent workflows for legacy code analysis, code migration and modernization, automated test generation and execution, code validation, defect detection, and remediation planning. Integrating agents with development tools, repositories, and system context to automate complex, multi-step engineering tasks while maintaining human oversight and control.Focusing on production-ready agentic architectures that incorporate tool integration, workflow orchestration, context management, evaluation, and observability. Implementing monitoring and tracing to improve agent transparency, diagnose failures, measure execution quality, and track performance across multi-agent workflows. Establishing guardrails, validation checkpoints, access controls, and human-in-the-loop

positions.title: Sr. Application Support and Developer
positions.description:
As a key developer, I collaborated with clients like Grainger, Arden Mills, and Carnival to support and enhance web applications, ensuring optimal system performance. I gathered user requirements and translated them into actionable use cases and Gherkin scenarios, working in an Agile SCRUM environment.
Key Responsibilities:
Front-End Development: Implemented business logic using Angular (v5, v7) with TypeScript, enhancing UI with Kendo UI and Knockout JS.
Back-End Development: Built and maintained RESTful Web APIs using .NET Core (v2), performing rigorous testing with xUnit and Selenium for integration tests.
Cloud & Event-Driven Solutions: Utilized Azure Functions, Service Bus, and MSMQ to enable reliable messaging and event-driven architectures.
Authentication & Security: Improved system security through OAuth authentication integrated with Azure AD and ADAL.
Database Optimization: Diagnosed and resolved poorly performing SQL queries, enhancing database performance in SQL Server 2016.
Monitoring & Support: Provided production support, resolving issues with Splunk and ensuring automated processes through Autosys.
Performance Testing: Conducted load and performance testing using Postman, collaborating with QA for validation.
Tools & Environment:
Frameworks & Languages: C#, ASP.NET, ADO.NET, .NET Core (2.0), Angular, TypeScript, RxJS.
Backend Technologies: RESTful Services, Azure Functions, Entity Framework, Service Bus.
Databases & Reporting: SQL Server 2016, SSRS, SSIS.
CI/CD & Version Control: Git, Azure DevOps, TeamCity, VSTS.
Testing & Monitoring: xUnit, Selenium, Postman, Splunk.
Project Management: Jira, Agile SCRUM.
Key Achievements:
Delivered critical application enhancements, boosting operational efficiency and user satisfaction.
Strengthened security by implementing OAuth and Azure AD authentication.
Improved system responsiveness by optimizing SQL queries.
Streamlined deployment with CI/CD pipelines, enabling faster and more reliable releases.

positions.title: Sr. Application Developer
positions.description:
As a key contributor to the Mobile Solutions Team, I designed and implemented advanced solutions to enhance the mobile app ecosystem. Leveraging cutting-edge technologies, I developed robust systems for real-time data streaming, service reliability, and cross-platform development.

Key Responsibilities:
Exception Monitoring: Designed a real-time tracking solution for mobile app exceptions using Kafka and Kibana, enabling comprehensive monitoring and analysis via dashboards.
Microservices Development: Built Microservices with Akka.NET to aggregate data from multiple web services into Couchbase, enabling efficient data delivery to the mobile wallet app through Sync Gateway.
Fault-Tolerant Messaging: Implemented a resilient messaging system with NServiceBus, enhancing fault tolerance and recovery using a Pub/Sub architecture.
Front-End Development: Created responsive UI components with Angular 2, Kendo UI, and Telerik, leveraging Couchbase’s Map-Reduce for optimized data queries.
Cross-Platform Development: Developed a Xamarin Proof of Concept (POC) for iOS and Android, exploring cross-platform capabilities.
Environment & Tools:
Frameworks & Languages: C#, ASP.NET, .NET (3.5-4.5), Akka.NET, NServiceBus, Angular 2, AngularJS, Kendo UI, Telerik.
Backend & Messaging: Kafka, RESTful Services, Couchbase, MongoDB, Pub/Sub Architecture.
Databases & Reporting: SQL Server 2016, SSRS, SSIS.
CI/CD & Version Control: Git, TFS, Azure DevOps.
Testing & Monitoring: Postman, Swagger, Splunk.
Project Management: Agile (SCRUM).
Key Achievements:
Delivered a real-time monitoring system for exceptions, improving incident response and system reliability.
Enhanced service communication reliability through NServiceBus.
Improved user experience by optimizing data synchronization between Couchbase and the mobile wallet app.
Validated cross-platform development strategies with Xamarin, setting the stage for future mobile initiatives.
